title: Goyak
subtitle: AI Real-Time Audio Dubbing & Live Translation
description: Experience seamless real-time translation and voice dubbing with AI. Goyak listens, translates, and speaks in your native language instantly.

realtime.title: Real-Time Dubbing
realtime.desc: Translates any system audio directly to your ears with minimal latency.

voice.title: Natural Voices
voice.desc: Powered by Gemini AI, preserving emotion, tone, and speaking style.

local.title: Local & Secure
local.desc: Runs completely locally on your desktop. Only audio chunks are sent to the AI API.

bilingual.title: Bilingual Interface
bilingual.desc: Full support for English and Persian (RTL) out of the box.

footer: Open-source and built with Tauri, React, and Gemini AI.
